headline: Pfizer Reports Q3 Earnings and Revenue Above Analyst Estimates
summary: Pfizer reported third-quarter earnings that beat consensus estimates by $0.14 alongside stronger-than-expected revenue.
why: Pfizer Inc. is one of the world's largest pharmaceutical and biotechnology corporations, and its quarterly results serve as a key health indicator for the broader healthcare sector.

impacts.name: Pfizer
impacts.why: Better-than-expected earnings and revenue reports typically boost investor sentiment.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Beating consensus earnings per share and revenue projections drives positive earnings revisions and higher demand for the stock.
